workflow.name: scan
workflow.purpose: Read local files, group exact byte-identical duplicates, and write a manifest JSON.

workflow.name: plan
workflow.purpose: Build a quarantine plan from a manifest. All actions start with approved=false.

workflow.name: dry_run_quarantine
workflow.purpose: Preview approved moves from a plan without moving files.

workflow.name: execute_quarantine
workflow.purpose: Move only approved=true plan entries into the quarantine folder.
